overview.text: The Redback Coffee Snake is a small ground snake of south-eastern Mexico and Central America. It looks a bit like a coral snake but is not venomous and rarely bites.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: South-eastern Mexico, Belize, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica and Panama.

habitat.text: Forest and savanna from sea level to about 2,200 m.

behaviour.text: Relies on hiding, escaping and bluffing: when alarmed it may flatten its whole body or freeze.

diet.text: Earthworms, slugs, small land snails and caecilians.
